package.name: f1tenth_ctl
package.description: Process manager CLI for the car: start and stop the stack, the LLM planner and the mission logger as systemd user units (in a container: runner processes), report READY, trigger the emergency stop and kill every ROS 2 process. JSON output for the Telegram bot. The CLI itself is stdlib Python and runs without ROS sourced; only its probe imports rclpy, inside the environment of config/ctl.env.
